sloka: न च मां स पिता तेभ्यो दत्तवान्राक्षसर्षभ ।कारणं तद्वदिष्यामि निशाचर निशामय ।। ७.१७.११ ॥
transliteration: na ca māṁ sa pitā tebhyo dattavānrākṣasarṣabha ।kāraṇaṁ tadvadiṣyāmi niśācara niśāmaya ।। 7.17.11 ॥

translations.english: Then, gods along with Gandharvas, Yakshas, Rakshasas, and Pannagas, all went to my father and sought my hand in marriage.
